Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS  
1. How will the seniority of persons appointed on compassionate grounds be determined? Persons appo1nted on compassionate ground in a particular year may be placed at the bottom of all the candidates recruited / appointed through direct recruitment, promotion, etc., in that year irrespective of the date of the joining of the candidate on  
compassionate ground.  
- Define "Pro forma Promotion".
